items.expected: Retain the full molecular connectivity, 165-atom composition and neutral charge. Document any candidate electron/spin state and show raw evidence that it exists or collapses. Distinguish formal oxidation-state accounting, orbital composition, spin density and atomic population charges; none is interchangeable with the others.

Provide quantitative, state-resolved electronic evidence and the corresponding molecular/state validation. If alternative initializations collapse, preserve the raw convergence/state evidence and describe what was actually tested.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Support the chosen electronic/bonding account using mutually informative evidence and explain why alternatives are retained, rejected or unresolved. The investigator chooses candidates and methods; no three-state or two-functional matrix is mandatory.

Evaluate dependence of the conclusion on electronic representation, numerical reliability and geometry as appropriate. Preserve the distinction between a robust state assignment and an ambiguous covalency interpretation.
